```plato
    //==
    // # Matrix4x4 construction — projections
    //
    // All of these map the view volume onto the [-1, 1] x [-1, 1] x [0, -1]
    // clip box of the System.Numerics / DirectX convention. The C# originals
    // throw for degenerate arguments; here the preconditions are UNCHECKED (see
    // the file header). https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/3D_projection

    // The perspective projection of a symmetric frustum described by its
    // vertical field of view. Preconditions (unchecked):
    // 0 < fieldOfView < half a turn, 0 < nearPlane < farPlane.
    CreatePerspectiveFieldOfView(_: Matrix4x4, fieldOfView: Angle, aspectRatio: Number, nearPlane: Number, farPlane: Number): Matrix4x4 {
        var yScale = 1.0 / (fieldOfView * 0.5).Tan;
        var xScale = yScale / aspectRatio;
        var range = farPlane / (nearPlane - farPlane);
        return (Number4(xScale, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
                Number4(0.0, yScale, 0.0, 0.0),
                Number4(0.0, 0.0, range, -1.0),
                Number4(0.0, 0.0, nearPlane * range, 0.0));
    }
```
